appearance_facts.fact: Title text 'Selected High-Growth Quarters: Ad Spend vs Sales' appears in large black font.
Y-axis is labeled 'Sales ($ thousands)' with tick marks ranging from 60 to 170 in increments of 10.
X-axis is labeled 'Advertising Spend ($ thousands)' with tick marks ranging from 25 to 75 in increments of 5.
Five blue circular data points are plotted, showing a strong positive linear trend from bottom-left to top-right.
Each data point is labeled with a quarter identifier (Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5, Q6) positioned slightly above and to the left of the corresponding dot.
Point Q2 is the lowest and leftmost data point, located at approximately x=30, y=68.
Point Q6 is the highest and rightmost data point, located at approximately x=70, y=167.
